description: This Java class configures and provides Spring beans for various API service clients used in the project, primarily related to the Apache Fineract platform. It initializes service instances for APIs such as LoansApi, SavingsApi, CurrencyApi, and many others, using an injected FineractClient.

classes.name: ApiConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines beans for various Fineract API services, facilitating dependency injection across the application.
